blocks.text: LDR ka principle (usool) yeh hai ke roshni parne par material ki conductivity barh jati hai. Andhere mein semiconductor mein bohat kam free electrons (charge carriers) hote hain, is liye resistance zyada hoti hai. Jab roshni ke photons material par parte hain to bahar wale orbits ke electrons ko energy dete hain aur unhein bijli guzarne ke liye azaad kar dete hain. Is se LDR ki resistance kam ho jati hai. LDR par jitni roshni pare utne free electrons bante hain; kam roshni se kam free electrons aur zyada resistance. Resistance ki is tabdeeli ko naap kar circuits mein roshni ki amount (kitni roshni hai) sense (mehsoos) ki jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is paragraph mein do dafa "free elections" chhapti hai; murad free electrons hai. Upar hum ne sahi lafz electrons likha hai.
